Agha Salman: We were not thinking about 335. Until 35th over, we were thinking about 
300. But the way we batted at the end made it possible. When you are batting with 
batters, you have a different mindset - you can take more risks, take on the spinners and 
that is what I did today. I did not want them (the spinners) to bowl at me and I wanted to 
be aggressive against them so that they would then bowl bad balls to me. I don't mind if 
I am playing 5 or 6. I just want to play for Pakistan and contribute as much as I can. 
New Zealand, meanwhile, would not be very pleased with how they let things slip 
towards the end. There was a phase, especially in the first half of the last ten overs 
where they seemed to be inching back into the game. Once Iftikhar opened up his 
shoulders, though, there was no looking back. They now have a mountain to climb and 
while they will believe they can hunt this down, this looks a very, very tough run-chase. 
Do join Rvel in a bit for the run-chase. 
7:24pm And so, Pakistan have put up 334 on the board, which is a massive score, 
considering the pitch has been a touch on the slower side. Their innings was held 
together by Babar, who stroked his way to his 18th ODI hundred. He also became the 
fastest to get to 5000 ODI runs in the process. Salman, too, played an exceptional knock 
- one that kept things ticking along very nicely in the middle overs. Haris, Iftikhar and 
Shaheen then played impactful cameos towards the end, with 38 runs coming off the 
last two overs. 
So Babar Azam continued to show his unquenchable thirst to score runs. You can just 
sit down and admire the genius of the man. Another top effort from him, leading from 
the front and notching up a sublime century. Iftikhar, Haris and Shaheen provided the 
impetus to the innings towards the end and it was exactly the kind of lift the home side 
was looking for. New Zealand might be feeling they conceded 30-40 extra runs when 
Shaheen started to swing freely and came out firing on all cylinders. I get a feeling, we'll 
have a mouth-watering chase in prospect.
